verdict.rationale: Tavily is an API-first service, so it runs headlessly by design. It offers key-based programmatic access via REST endpoints and Python/JS SDKs with sync and async clients. Automation support includes production-environment rate limits with 429/retry-after handling, per-request usage logs, and project/session attribution for agent workflows. A community user also reports wrapping Tavily in a CLI that agents drive for automated research. Missing for 10: explicit CI-specific guidance (e.g., GitHub Actions or env-var key setup), documented non-interactive auth for the `tvly` CLI (`tvly login` opens a browser), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
